candidates.name: Practice guide 40 supplement 4 - detailed boundary agreements and determined boundaries
verified_facts: Updated 1 June 2026 and distinguishes general boundaries, boundary agreements and determined boundaries.
Determined-boundary measurement plans require horizontal measurements accurate to +/-10mm from defined permanent features.
National Grid coordinates used for a determined boundary require absolute accuracy +/-300mm and relative accuracy +/-10mm, with professional certification.
semantic_limits: These are legal boundary-survey tolerances, not LiDAR vertical RMSE and not evidence that the measured parcels already have determined boundaries.

candidates.name: Practice guide 40 - guide overview of Land Registry plans
verified_facts: The guide routes boundary, determined-boundary, title-plan and application-plan questions to separate supplements.
The title-plan supplement covers purpose, scale, surveys and title-plan maintenance.
The boundary supplement covers physical/legal/general/fixed/determined boundary concepts.
semantic_limits: Authority routing does not itself establish exact parcel geometry, survey lineage or elevation.

candidates.name: Coverage Implementation Schema - ReferenceableGridCoverage Extension with Corrigendum
verified_facts: Approved OGC Implementation Standard version 1.0.1 published 20 January 2019.
Provides instantiable referenceable-grid structures whose transformations map grid positions to coordinates in an external CRS.
Referenceable-grid semantics are distinct from assuming a simple rectified regular grid.
semantic_limits: Grid-model conformance is structural evidence; it does not validate EA elevation values or parcel-specific survey provenance.
